newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti CEO to be Omnitel vice-chairman.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti CEO to be Omnitel vice-chairman.

text.p: Italian mobile phone group Omnitel-Pronto Italia said Roberto Colaninno, the chief executive officer of Olivetti, had been nominated as Omnitel's new vice-chairman.

An Omnitel statement said: "In a meeting today, at the proposal of the chairman Carlo Peretti, Roberto Colaninno was appointed to the board prior to being named vice-chairman at the next board meeting."
Omnitel said board member Francesco Caio, Colaninno's short-lived predecessor at Olivetti, had resigned.
Peretti said in the statement Omnitel had won 35 percent of Italy's GSM mobile phone market in less than a year of offering its service.
Omnitel Pronto Italia is Italy's second mobile phone network manager, competing with state-controlled Telecom Italia Mobile (TIM).
Omnitel is 70 percent controlled by a consortium Omnitel Sistemi Radiocellulari Italiani, in which information technology group Olivetti is the largest shareholder.
The remaining 30 percent of the company is controlled by another consortium, Pronto Italia, which includes Germany's Mannesmann and U.S. group Air Touch.
